# Prompt Injection Detector

> A prompt-injection and jailbreak classifier with a Rust n-gram core, a fine-tuned small transformer and a leakage-safe benchmark against a published detector.

Languages: Python, Rust. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector

## Source

- [rust/src/dedup.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/rust/src/dedup.rs): Near-duplicate grouping with MinHash and banded LSH, used to build leakage-safe splits: texts in one group always land in the same split.
- [rust/src/features.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/rust/src/features.rs): Hashed character and word n-gram features with sublinear TF-IDF weighting.
- [rust/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/rust/src/lib.rs): Rust core of prompt-injection-detector.
- [rust/src/model.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/rust/src/model.rs): Linear scoring and FTRL-Proximal training over hashed TF-IDF features.
- [rust/src/normalize.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/rust/src/normalize.rs): Text normalization that undoes common obfuscation before featurization.
- [rust/src/python.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/rust/src/python.rs): PyO3 bindings, built by maturin into the `prompt_injection_detector.pid_rs` module.
- [rust/src/rng.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/rust/src/rng.rs): SplitMix64, the seeded generator shared with the Python reference implementation.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/__init__.py): Prompt-injection and jailbreak detection with a Rust n-gram core.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/attacks.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/attacks.py): Rule-based adversarial rewrites of an attack prompt, for robustness evaluation.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/cli.py): Command line interface: ``python -m prompt_injection_detector <command>``.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/data.py): Dataset assembly: 13 public injection, jailbreak and benign prompt sources, exact and near-duplicate removal, and leakage-safe splits.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/dedup.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/dedup.py): Near-duplicate grouping with MinHash and banded LSH for leakage-safe splits.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/features.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/features.py): Hashed character and word n-gram features with sublinear TF-IDF weighting.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/ftrl.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/ftrl.py): FTRL-Proximal logistic regression (McMahan et al., 2013), reference implementation.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/metrics.py): Detection metrics: AUROC, ROC points, TPR at a fixed FPR, thresholds and bootstrap CIs.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/model.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/model.py): The linear detector: hashed n-gram TF-IDF features scored by a logistic model.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/normalize.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/normalize.py): Text normalization that undoes common obfuscation before featurization.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/rng.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/rng.py): SplitMix64, the seeded generator shared with the Rust core.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/service.py): HTTP service: scores prompts with the linear detector.
- [src/prompt_injection_detector/transformer.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/prompt-injection-detector/blob/main/src/prompt_injection_detector/transformer.py): Transformer detectors: fine-tuning a small encoder and scoring with any sequence-classification checkpoint (including the reference model).
